title: DEUS Canonical World Palette Architecture & Material Ramps Registry

policy.sheetCapPolicy: NO ARBITRARY 32-COLOR CAP PER PACKED TILESET SHEET. Tileset sheets are containers containing the union of multiple material ramps.
policy.enforcementLevel: Color discipline is enforced at Material Family and Individual Asset level.
policy.pixelDensityRule: Author at 1:1 Native Resolution; draw strictly from canonical material ramps and Master Palette.

ground.role: Lowest contrast, quiet negative space for tactical gameplay and readability
ground.guidance: Ground tiles must not compete with entities; avoid jarring 1-pixel high-contrast speckles.

vegetationProps.role: Moderate contrast, distinct silhouettes, organic clustering
vegetationProps.guidance: Foliage and props use clear shadow masses and restrained rim highlights.

characters.role: Clear separation from ground and vegetation, prioritized readability
characters.guidance: Characters maintain distinctive silhouettes, local contrast, and readable equipment.

interactiveObjects.role: High readability, distinct highlights, interactive affordance
interactiveObjects.guidance: Chests, doors, levers, and items pop against ground backgrounds.

supernaturalVFX.role: Highest selective saturation, full-range contrast, incandescent luminance
supernaturalVFX.guidance: Reserved exclusively for spells, divine miracles, and molten lava hazard nodes.

simpleClutter.guidance: Small pebbles, single mushrooms, leaf piles, loose bones.

commonWorldProp.guidance: Barrels, crates, small boulders, market stalls, bushes.

treeLargeVegetation.guidance: Combines 1 bark ramp (3-5 tones) + 1-2 foliage ramps (4-6 tones).

complexStructure.guidance: Multi-material architectural units combining timber, masonry, iron, and thatch.

fullPackedTilesetSheet.guidance: A packed tileset sheet is a container holding multiple materials. NO arbitrary 32 or 64 total cap applies. All pixels must adhere to constituent ramps and the Master Palette.
